key: HARDY: Yo, I see you made it out too, old man.
en: HARDY: Yo, I see you made it out too, old man.
ja: ハーディ: よお、じいさんも抜け出せたみたいだな。

key: RADOMUS: It would seem so.
en: RADOMUS: It would seem so.
ja: ラドマス: そのようだな。

key: And for the record, while I still maintain that I am at least as young at heart as the next wayward Trainer,
en: And for the record, while I still maintain that I am at least as young at heart as the next wayward Trainer,
ja: 念のため言っておくが、私は気持ちの上では、そこらの向こう見ずなトレーナーに負けず若いつもりだ。

key: This terrain alone does not need your help to remind me of my age.
en: This terrain alone does not need your help to remind me of my age.
ja: だが、この地形だけで十分、自分の歳を思い知らされる。お前の助けなど要らん。

key: I blush to admit that I'm still parked here only for lack of breath.
en: I blush to admit that I'm still parked here only for lack of breath.
ja: 恥ずかしながら、ここに突っ立っているのは息切れのせいだ。

key: HARDY: Huh, ain't you got your Pokémon helpin' you out?
en: HARDY: Huh, ain't you got your Pokémon helpin' you out?
ja: ハーディ: あれ、ポケモンに手伝ってもらってないのか?

key: RADOMUS: As it turns out, there are not too many Psychic types that would learn Rock Climb...
en: RADOMUS: As it turns out, there are not too many Psychic types that would learn Rock Climb...
ja: ラドマス: 実のところ、いわのぼりを覚えるエスパータイプはそう多くはなくてね…

key: Nevertheless, we'll get there.
en: Nevertheless, we'll get there.
ja: とはいえ、いずれたどり着くさ。

key: HARDY: Nah, mate, I'll help you out.
en: HARDY: Nah, mate, I'll help you out.
ja: ハーディ: いや、俺が手伝ってやるよ。

key: Wouldn't want you to pull your back out or somethin'.
en: Wouldn't want you to pull your back out or somethin'.
ja: 腰でも痛めたら大変だからな。

key: RADOMUS: Just how old do you think I am...
en: RADOMUS: Just how old do you think I am...
ja: ラドマス: 一体私を何歳だと思っているんだ…

key: Incidentally, I don't suppose you have a sense of whereabouts we are here?
en: Incidentally, I don't suppose you have a sense of whereabouts we are here?
ja: ところで、ここがどのあたりか見当はつくかね?

key: I slid down further than I would like to admit, and I've been a bit lost for direction.
en: I slid down further than I would like to admit, and I've been a bit lost for direction.
ja: 認めたくないほど下まで滑り落ちてしまってね、方向感覚が少しおかしくなっている。

key: HARDY: No clue, but wherever it is, we're probably off the grid,
en: HARDY: No clue, but wherever it is, we're probably off the grid,
ja: ハーディ: さっぱりわかんねえけど、どこだろうと、たぶん奴らの目が届かない場所だ、

key: And we're gonna use that to our advantage!
en: And we're gonna use that to our advantage!
ja: それを逆に利用してやろうぜ!

key: RADOMUS: I did see Meteor has set up quite the encampment.
en: RADOMUS: I did see Meteor has set up quite the encampment.
ja: ラドマス: メテオがなかなかの陣を張っているのは見えたな。

key: HARDY: With any luck, we'll come out in a spot we can hit 'em from!
en: HARDY: With any luck, we'll come out in a spot we can hit 'em from!
ja: ハーディ: 運が良けりゃ、あいつらを狙える場所に出られるかもな!

key: RADOMUS: Hmm...
en: RADOMUS: Hmm...
ja: ラドマス: ふむ…

key: To that end, I may have an idea.
en: To that end, I may have an idea.
ja: そのことなら、一つ案がある。

key: HARDY: Oh yeah? Let's hear it!
en: HARDY: Oh yeah? Let's hear it!
ja: ハーディ: マジか? 聞かせてくれよ!

key: RADOMUS: It takes a bit of a sore neck to notice it from that room, but there is a large stalactite hanging some way above where they've set up.
en: RADOMUS: It takes a bit of a sore neck to notice it from that room, but there is a large stalactite hanging some way above where they've set up.
ja: ラドマス: あの部屋からだと少々首が痛むが、彼らが陣を張っている場所のかなり上に、大きなしょうにゅう石が垂れ下がっているのが見える。

key: I believe it could be convinced to meet them.
en: I believe it could be convinced to meet them.
ja: あれを説得して、奴らのところまで会いに行かせることもできるだろう。

key: HARDY: No way, mate! That'd put Aya in danger too!
en: HARDY: No way, mate! That'd put Aya in danger too!
ja: ハーディ: 冗談だろ、相棒! それじゃアヤまで危険にさらすことになる!

key: RADOMUS: Too true.
en: RADOMUS: Too true.
ja: ラドマス: 確かにその通りだ。

key: If Gardevoir were here, it would be as simple as having her teleport her out, but...
en: If Gardevoir were here, it would be as simple as having her teleport her out, but...
ja: サーナイトがここにいれば、テレポートで彼女を連れ出すだけで済むのだが…

key: HARDY: There's gotta be another way!
en: HARDY: There's gotta be another way!
ja: ハーディ: 他にも方法があるはずだ!

key: RADOMUS: Indeed.
en: RADOMUS: Indeed.
ja: ラドマス: そのとおり。

key: Well, I wonder who can help us with this...
en: Well, I wonder who can help us with this...
ja: さて、これを手伝ってくれるのは誰だろうな…

key: HARDY: For now, let's go on and see what we can see!
en: HARDY: For now, let's go on and see what we can see!
ja: ハーディ: とりあえず、先に進んで様子を見てみようぜ!

key: You're with me, old man.
en: You're with me, old man.
ja: じいさんも一緒に来いよ。

key: RADOMUS: ...
en: RADOMUS: ...
ja: ラドマス: …

key: I suppose I don't have room to object.
en: I suppose I don't have room to object.
ja: 反論する余地もなさそうだな。

key: VICTORIA: It looks like this is a dead end too?
en: VICTORIA: It looks like this is a dead end too?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ここも行き止まりみたい?

key: Now what are we going to do...
en: Now what are we going to do...
ja: これからどうしよう…

key: TITANIA: And dead end.
en: TITANIA: And dead end.
ja: ティタニア: それで行き止まり、と。

key: Of course it is.
en: Of course it is.
ja: 当然だけどね。

key: VICTORIA: Um, \PN, look out!
en: VICTORIA: Um, \PN, look out!
ja: ヴィクトリア: あの、\PN、危ない!

key: TITANIA: Move!
en: TITANIA: Move!
ja: ティタニア: 動いて!

key: VICTORIA: You're okay, right?
en: VICTORIA: You're okay, right?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 大丈夫よね?

key: That was...
en: That was...
ja: 今のは…

key: TITANIA: It's always something, huh.
en: TITANIA: It's always something, huh.
ja: ティタニア: いつも何かしらあるわね。

key: SAPHIRA: You're unhurt?
en: SAPHIRA: You're unhurt?
ja: サファイラ: 怪我はない?

key: VICTORIA: We're fine. And you?
en: VICTORIA: We're fine. And you?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 平気です。そちらは?

key: SAPHIRA: Careless.
en: SAPHIRA: Careless.
ja: サファイラ: うかつだった。

key: TITANIA: Peachy.
en: TITANIA: Peachy.
ja: ティタニア: 絶好調よ。

key: SAPHIRA: I was careless.
en: SAPHIRA: I was careless.
ja: サファイラ: 私の油断だった。

key: I should have expected a cowardly strike like that from Sirius.
en: I should have expected a cowardly strike like that from Sirius.
ja: シリウスならあんなひきょうな一撃を仕掛けてくることくらい、予想しておくべきだった。

key: I'll prove they're all he's good for.
en: I'll prove they're all he's good for.
ja: あれが彼の精一杯だということを証明してみせる。

key: VICTORIA: Well...
en: VICTORIA: Well...
ja: ヴィクトリア: えっと…

key: I guess that gives us a way forward?
en: I guess that gives us a way forward?
ja: これで先に進む道ができたってこと?

key: TITANIA: I can think of someone like that.
en: TITANIA: I can think of someone like that.
ja: ティタニア: そういう奴に心当たりがあるわ。

key: Well, looks like the door's open.
en: Well, looks like the door's open.
ja: まあ、扉は開いてるみたいね。

key: Convenient.
en: Convenient.
ja: 都合がいいこと。

key: Let's go.
en: Let's go.
ja: 行きましょう。

key: I have my whole team to thank for bringing me this far.
en: I have my whole team to thank for bringing me this far.
ja: ここまで来られたのは、チームのみんなのおかげだ。

key: Hopefully we can pull through for whatever's next.
en: Hopefully we can pull through for whatever's next.
ja: この先も何とか乗り切れるといいが。

key: I made myself promise.
en: I made myself promise.
ja: 自分自身に誓ったんだ。

key: I don't EVER break my promises.
en: I don't EVER break my promises.
ja: 俺は約束を破ったことなんて一度もない。
